predictions.articleTitle: Nigeria vs Tanzania Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Lookman Lead Super Eagles Without Osimhen?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Nigeria to secure a controlled home victory in Uyo against depleted Tanzania in an Under 2.5 Goals contest.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win behind Ademola Lookman, Alex Iwobi, and set-piece aerial pressure (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals driven by Osimhen, Chukwueze, Mzize, and Samatta absences (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Nigeria 2:1 concession contingency via Novatus Miroshi and Charles M'Mombwa transitions (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)
